summary.headline: Senco Gold Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 67% YoY and EBITDA margin fell to 7.0% (INR213 crores) on gold-price, discounting and one-off cost effects.
summary.overview: Senco crossed INR3,000 crores of sales in a single quarter, with consolidated revenue up about 67% YoY and retail up 50%, same-store sales growth around 39%. April was the strong month (about INR1,500-1,600 crores), while May and June moderated to roughly INR500-600 crores a month amid West Bengal elections, Adhik Maas and heat wave. Reported EBITDA was INR213 crores at 7.0% margin and consolidated PAT INR101 crores at 3.3%, with margin pressure from other expenses (about INR195 crores vs about INR80 crores a year earlier), a gold-price decline, discounting and GML-related finance cost. Management retained FY27 guidance of 20%+ value growth and a 7.5%-7.8% sustainable operational EBITDA margin, and said July and August are running about 25% YoY ahead.

segments.name: Retail / owned and franchise stores
segments.commentary: Retail sales +50% YoY, growth broad-based across zones including newly launched Central region (7 stores) and Delhi NCR; 3 COCO and 4 franchise stores added plus 1 Sennes showroom in Q1.

segments.name: Diamond jewellery
segments.commentary: Value +43% YoY and volume +18%, with management flagging stud-ratio improvement as a margin lever.

segments.name: Factory subsidiary
segments.commentary: Captive design and jewellery supply hub performing well, enabling about 100 designs per day; more than 150,000 designs a year.

segments.name: Sennes / Sennes Fashion / Dubai entity
segments.commentary: Start-up phase (lab-grown diamonds, perfume, leather bags); together weighed on consolidated PAT.

segments.name: Aham (men's titanium-gold-diamond range)
segments.commentary: Newly launched, priced INR20,000 to INR1 lakh.

guidance_outlook: FY27 value growth guidance retained at 20%+, with 25%+ possible depending on the year; implies revenue above INR10,000 crores vs INR8,430 crores in FY26; revisit after Q3.
Sustainable operational EBITDA margin guided at 7.5%-7.8% for the full year, over a normalised 2-3 quarter period; management aims to move toward 8% via higher stud ratio.
PAT margin target of around 4.5%-5%; ROE and ROCE targeted toward the 20% range.
12-15 further store openings planned in the rest of FY27, majority franchise, focused on East and North India.
Q2 expected to be seasonally softer and a planning/inventory-build quarter; July and August running about 25% YoY growth and 8%-10% above May-June level.
Longer term: INR20,000 crores+ revenue and 300+ stores in 4-5 years (currently ~200 stores).
capex_capacity: Store network at around 200 stores; 12-15 more openings planned for the rest of FY27, mainly franchise.
Inventory of roughly INR5,000 crores; inventory per store guided at 15-18 kg to 35-40 kg depending on market.
Management estimates INR8,000-9,000 crores of inventory may be needed to reach INR20,000 crores revenue.
Inventory to be built from September ahead of festive season, then sold through.
Factory subsidiary supports about 100 new designs per day.
demand_pricing: Old gold exchange accounted for ~43% of sales quantity on a blended basis, above 55% at owned stores.
Customers shifted to lightweight, design-led, lower-ticket jewellery (9-carat, 14-carat, lightweight ranges), with grammage down ~1% on a 24-carat-equivalent basis.
Discounting and schemes intensified after the customs-duty increase; management cites competitive intensity as a margin drag.
Monthly mix: April ~55% of quarterly sales; May-June ~45% combined.
Hedging held at about 50% under Board policy; management intends to move toward 75%-80% as gold volatility eases.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 guidance only 20%+ after a strong Q1, and what is July-August trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says it has historically guided conservatively; July and August are running about 25% YoY and about 8%-10% above the May-June level, with a stronger build expected in October-November.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses jump to about INR195-229 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to marketing, store renovations in lean season, and customer offers and schemes; it said this run rate is quarter-specific and expected to subside.

qa_highlights.question: Why was GML availability constrained and finance cost up?
qa_highlights.answer: Banks restricted GML in March-April amid duty uncertainty and efforts to curb gold imports; company bought more gold locally and cut GML exposure, and says GML is now more available.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 7.5%-7.8% EBITDA range operational and what is the hedge effect?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed the range is operational, assuming a neutral gold-price environment and appropriate hedging; hedge at about 50% is intended to still deliver it.

qa_highlights.question: What was the customs-duty gain in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management estimated a gross gain of INR12-15 crores for the roughly 45 days of impact in Q1, partly offset by schemes; benefit expected over 2-3 quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Why is cash flow from operations expected to look negative and what is inventory strategy?
qa_highlights.answer: Management will disclose CFO with H1; lower GML borrowing may make CFO appear negative on accounting basis. Inventory days ~152, reduced on store-by-store basis.

risks_watch: Margin volatility: Q1 margin at 7.0% vs guided 7.5%-7.8%; hedge ratio at ~50% leaves exposure to gold-price moves.
Other expenses (~INR195 crores) and discounting: management says quarter-specific, watch whether they normalise in Q2.
Inventory days at ~152 and capital efficiency; ROE/ROCE target of 20% depends on inventory productivity.
Cash flow from operations not yet disclosed; management expects it may be negative in Q1 on lower GML borrowing.
Sennes and Dubai subsidiaries weighing on consolidated PAT; 65-70% of business from Eastern India and West Bengal, concentration risk.
Discrepancy: business update reported 62% growth vs 67% in limited review numbers; management attributed gap to accounting adjustments.

key_quotes: We have delivered a strong Q1 performance, achieving record sales and crossing INR3,000 crores in a single quarter.
For now, you may look at our guidance as 20%+ and perhaps 25%+, depending on how the rest of the year averages out.
This run rate will not continue, and we expect it to subside in the upcoming quarters.
It is more an accounting presentation issue than a reflection of business reality.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and the July-August recovery, but conservative on FY27 guidance, which management repeatedly framed as 20%+ with 25%+ possible. Defensive on margins, other expenses, cash flow and the gap between the business update and limited-review numbers, attributing them to quarter-specific or accounting factors.
